# K V Paulose and Sons Pvt Ltd

> Class A Government civil contractor from Ernakulam, Kerala, India. A Kunnel family construction business since 1919, building roads, irrigation schemes, dams, canals, hospitals, churches, commercial buildings and major infrastructure across Palakkad, Thrissur, Ernakulam, Idukki, Kottayam, Alappuzha, Pathanamthitta, Kollam and Thiruvananthapuram.

- Website: https://kvpsons.com/
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 94963 34344
- Email: managingdirector@kvpsons.com
- Based in: Ernakulam district, Kerala, India
- Managing Director: Amal Paul Kunnel (with Sharath Paul Kunnel)
- Founded: 1919, during the British Raj, by Paily Yoyak
- Licence: Class A Government contractor (family licence since 1940)
- Clients: 55+ government and institutional clients, including PWD, the Irrigation Department, Kochi Metro Rail Ltd, Kochi Refinery, the Harbour Engineering Department, Kochi Municipal Corporation, RBDCK and PMGSY

## Services

- Road and highway construction, road widening
- Lift irrigation, dams and canals
- Government (PWD) and private buildings, including hospitals
- Churches and religious institutions
- Commercial buildings such as hypermarkets

## Featured projects

- Kochi Metro Phase II, Airport–Seaport Road widening: ₹79 crore, 4.5 km to six lanes, for Kochi Metro Rail Ltd (Kakkanad to Infopark)
- W&C Hospital, Vaikom: ₹32 crore hospital complex for PWD Buildings Division, on the banks of Vembanad Lake
- St. Mary's Malankara Catholic Church, Anchalpetty: church, parish hall, parsonage and land development in about eleven months
- Lola Hypermarket, Kolenchery: 53,000 sq ft of civil works and land development in seven months

## History

- 1919: Paily Yoyak starts the family construction business (British Raj licence) with lift-irrigation schemes along the Periyar Valley
- 1940: Class A licence: K U Paily and K U John
- 1970: Class A licence: K P Yoyaki and K P Varghese (Kallada, Idamalayar, Sholayar and Malankara dams)
- 1980: Class A licence: K V Paulose forms K V Paulose and Sons Pvt Ltd
- 1990: Class A licence: K U Paulosekutty
- Today: Amal Paul Kunnel (Managing Director) and Sharath Paul Kunnel
